# Togetherall

> > Togetherall is a clinically moderated, anonymous online mental health peer support community providing 24/7 access to trained peers and self-guided resources.

The platform serves diverse populations including young people in Scotland, students, military families, and NHS communities. Togetherall combines peer support with clinical oversight through its Guardian Council and Trained Peers Programme, offering evidence-based digital mental health interventions alongside community connection.

## Key Topics

- Peer support and anonymous community
- Guardian Council and clinical moderation
- Trained Peers Programme
- 24/7 mental health support
- Scottish young people access (Young Scotland)
- Digital mental health safeguarding
- Stress management and mindfulness
- Student mental health
- NHS and local authority partnerships
- Loneliness and isolation support
- Depression and suicide prevention
- COVID-19 mental health response
- Military family wellbeing
- Evidence-based research and outcomes

## Access and Getting Started

- [Scottish Young People | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/join/youngscotland): Free anonymous mental health support for Scottish young people (24/7)
- [Trained Peers on Togetherall | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/trained-peers): Trained Peers Programme: volunteer peer support with lived experience

## Clinical Governance and Safety

- [Built on a foundation of clinical rigor and integrity: The team behind Togetherall's safe, supportive community | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/blog/built-on-a-foundation-of-clinical-rigor-and-integrity-the-team-behind-togetheralls-safe-supportive-community): Clinical team and Guardian Council ensuring safe moderated peer support
- [The Guardian Council 2024 – Trained Peers Report  | Togetherall Report | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/campaigns/the-guardian-council-2025): 2024 Guardian Council report on Trained Peers supporting ethical community

## Mental Health Support Resources

- [Tackling Our Demons – the Low Down on Depression | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/support-articles/tackling-our-demons-the-low-down-on-depression): Understanding depression: symptoms, recovery, and asking for help
- [Are we all just kind of lonely? How to manage feelings of loneliness and isolation | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/support-articles/are-we-all-just-kind-of-lonely-how-to-manage-feelings-of-loneliness-and-isolation): Managing loneliness and isolation in the age of social media connection
- [Being Present: Slow Down and Smell the Coffee | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/support-articles/being-present-slow-down-and-smell-the-coffee): Stress management guide: mindfulness and being present techniques
- [Connecting More in Relationships: How to Listen and Learn | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/support-articles/connecting-more-in-relationships-how-to-listen-and-learn): Active listening skills guide for better relationships and communication
- [I was worried about him, but I was also worried about where I could get support… | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/support-articles/navigating-life-as-a-military-family): Military family mental health support story featuring Lisa Hancock
- [The power of community: How Hector's House and Togetherall are supporting mental health | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/support-articles/the-power-of-community-how-hectors-house-and-togetherall-are-supporting-mental-health): Hector's House partnership for suicide prevention and mental wellbeing

## Stress Awareness and Management

- [Stress Awareness Month: How can we get through moments of high stress? | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/blog/stress-awareness-month-how-can-we-get-through-moments-of-high-stress): Stress Awareness Month: coping strategies and mindfulness techniques
- [Stress Awareness Month: Where does stress come from and what causes stress?  | Togetherall](https://togetherall.com/en-gb/blog/stress-awareness-month-where-does-stress-come-from-and-what-causes-stress): Understanding stress causes: eustress vs distress and Yerkes-Dodson law
